from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document regarding its title and bibliography."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper/document")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of papers cited in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of parsed information from all documents in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
